prompt: Inspectors fill out forms in basements with no signal and need them to upload later.
why: Save locally and sync when connected.
trap: Optimistic UI assumes the request will be sent now.

prompt: A news app should open and show saved articles on a subway with no connection.
tells: on a subway with no connection
why: Cache the app shell and articles with a service worker and local storage.
trap: Static pages still need a network.

prompt: Two offline devices edit the same note, and both sync later.
why: Offline-first needs a merge strategy (e.g. CRDTs or last-write rules).
trap: Conflicts are the hard part of offline-first.

prompt: When the network drops, the app should keep accepting new entries and send them in order once back online.
tells: send them in order once back online
why: An outbox of pending writes, flushed on reconnect.
trap: It looks optimistic, but the key is surviving offline.

prompt: A notes app should let you write on a flight and upload when you land.
trap: Optimistic UI still needs the network soon.

prompt: A field-survey app stores hundreds of photos and forms on the device until connectivity returns.
tells: stores hundreds of photos and forms on the device
why: Use IndexedDB plus a sync queue.
trap: localStorage is too small for this.

prompt: Form submissions made offline should be sent automatically when the network returns, even if the tab was closed.
tells: sent automatically when the network returns
even if the tab was closed
why: A service worker with Background Sync can retry after the tab closes.
trap: Where supported; elsewhere, retry on next open.

prompt: A PWA's app shell should load instantly from the device cache, with data fetched afterward.
tells: load instantly from the device cache
why: Cache-first app shell via a service worker.
trap: It's the foundation of offline-capable apps.
